title: Phax : Potion Time+
description: Potion Time+ extends the duration of vanilla potions to better fit long adventures
body:
Potion Time+ enhances the vanilla experience by increasing potion duration, allowing players to focus on exploration, combat, and creativity without constantly reapplying effects.

Designed to feel natural, balanced, and fully compatible with vanilla gameplay, this mod does not add unnecessary complexity — it simply makes potions last longer in a clean and immersive way.
